subject: Aligned evaluation slate, timeline, and seed MAP (initial draft)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Claire Chen <claire.chen@orbitai.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aligned evaluation slate, timeline, and seed MAP (initial draft)

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As promised, I put together a short starter MAP and a 30-day acceptance matrix so your engineering and product teams can validate end-to-end behavior on a small sample. The goal here is to create a lightweight, shared plan that clears the path to a scoped pilot and then to a production pilot if the metrics look good.

What I attached / linked:
- initial_map_gdoc (link below) — narrative MAP with roles, milestones, and ask owners
- 30d_acceptance_matrix.xlsx — concrete test cases and success thresholds (latency / accuracy / cost per token)

Suggested next steps:
1) Internal review by OrbitAI tech + product this week (Claire)
2) 30-minute alignment call to pick a week for a 7-day sample run (Jasmine, Claire, Jonas)
3) Confirm dataset slice and demo cadence; Redwood to provision a sandbox instance for the sample run

I put a couple of placeholders in the doc for demo dates and the acceptance metric owners — please edit directly or tell me who should own each row.

Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-initial-map-draft (Initial MAP — please request access if you hit a perms error)

Attachments: initial_map_gdoc (link), 30d_acceptance_matrix.xlsx (attached)

Thanks — looking forward to your feedback.

—
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192


From: Claire Chen <claire.chen@orbitai.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligned evaluation slate, timeline, and seed MAP (initial draft)

Jasmine —

Nice work on this. I reviewed the doc quickly and left inline comments around the demo cadence and the recommended sample size (we were thinking larger than your placeholder, ~5k records). A couple quick notes:

- Our security folks asked whether the sandbox instance will be VPC-peered or if we should provide an obfuscated copy of our dataset.
- Can you confirm expected token cost for a 7-day run at 5k? We need to model this for our procurement team.
- For acceptance metrics, product would own "recall@k" and ops will own latency SLO verification.

We can do a 30-minute alignment call on Friday (4/23) at 10am PT — does that work for you and Jonas?

Thanks,
Claire
Product Lead, OrbitAI
claire.chen@orbitai.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Aligned evaluation slate, timeline, and seed MAP (initial draft)

Looping in a couple quick operational points before Friday:

- Pricing / procurement: if OrbitAI wants to run a 5k sample over 7 days, estimate a mid-range cost of $X-$Y (I attached a simple cost model). We should give them a conservative upper bound for procurement.
- Security: Jonas, can you confirm whether the sandbox will be VPC-peered (preferred) or if OrbitAI will upload an obfuscated dataset? Claire asked above.
- Owners: I suggest we propose a two-week SLA for sandbox availability so infra has breathing room for onboarding + perf tuning.

I've updated the MAP doc with a "procurement notes" section and attached the cost model. Please review and approve any language I added before Friday's call.

Attachments: cost_model_7day_5k.xlsx

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligned evaluation slate, timeline, and seed MAP (initial draft)

Thanks all — Friday 4/23 at 10am PT works for our side. For the prep call I can bring a short runbook:

- confirmation of dataset slice (5k sample with small-hotset holdout)
- list of the three acceptance test cases we'll run and owners (we'll map to your matrix)
- procurement notes (confirming Ballpark numbers from Marissa)

Jasmine — can you send a calendar invite and include the sandbox VPC peering notes (Jonas to confirm endpoints)? Also, we'll need the initial_map_gdoc to be "commenter" for Claire / Ben so they can annotate.

Ben
Head of Ops, OrbitAI
ben.jacobs@orbitai.com
